lore.redomesticate.collar_tag: A tag that can rename a pet.
lore.redomesticate.drum: A drum that commands all of your pets in a large area to stay, follow, or wander. Flux Power commands the pets of whoever placed it.
lore.redomesticate.feather_on_a_stick: A feather dangled from a stick for playing with Cats.
lore.redomesticate.deed_of_ownership: A deed that transfers ownership of a pet to another player.
